fields.description: Evergreens is DAMAC’s one- and two-bedroom apartment collection in DAMAC Hills 2. The low-rise residential setting combines balconies, parkland outlooks and pool-side recreation, with further attractions in the surrounding master community.

overview: The brochure shows balconies opening towards parkland and a shared pool setting. A two-bedroom example has two bathrooms and two separate balconies. Wider DAMAC Hills 2 attractions belong to the master community; their access conditions and delivery should be checked separately from the apartment specification.
research.locationNote: The branded fact sheet places Evergreens close to the main entrance of DAMAC Hills 2. Check the chosen tower and entrance route rather than inferring exact travel times from community-level marketing.
research.priceNote: The fact sheet advertises one bedroom from AED 550,000 and two bedrooms from AED 1.1 m. Its example list includes a 541 sq ft one-bedroom at AED 554,000. Property Finder’s later entry is around AED 1.172 m and marks the release sold out; none establishes current available stock.
research.paymentNote: The original 70/30 schedule starts with 20%, followed by monthly instalments and construction milestones totalling 50%, then 30% at completion. The grouped monthly rows retain the published pattern. The fact sheet states the 4% DLD fee is additional to the initial deposit. Confirm current terms.
research.handoverNote: The fact sheet estimates December 2026 and Property Finder gives Q4 2026. This does not verify physical completion or a guaranteed date for a particular unit.
